mapper.select: SELECT id,site_project_id,class_name,page_type,status,has_front_channel,is_deleted,list_page_url,detail_page_url,list_page_template,detail_page_template,parent_id FROM t_oneshot WHERE site_project_id=#{siteId} AND deleted=0 AND is_deleted=0 AND has_front_channel=1 AND page_type IN (0,1) ORDER BY id
mapper.sql:
SELECT 'content' kind,c.id record_id,c.class_id menu_id,c.title,COALESCE(c.public_search_text,c.title) search_text,c.create_time sort_time FROM t_contents c JOIN t_oneshot m ON m.id=c.class_id WHERE m.site_project_id=#{q.siteId} AND (c.site_project_id=#{q.siteId} OR c.site_project_id IS NULL) AND c.deleted=0 AND c.status=1 AND YEAR(c.create_time)=#{q.year} AND MONTH(c.create_time)=#{q.month} AND c.entry_into_force_time<=NOW() AND c.expiration_time>=NOW() AND m.deleted=0 AND m.is_deleted=0 AND m.has_front_channel=1 AND m.page_type=1 AND m.id AND COALESCE(c.public_search_text,c.title) LIKE #{q.likePattern} ESCAPE '\\'
UNION ALL SELECT 'singlePage' kind,m.id record_id,m.id menu_id,m.class_name title,COALESCE(m.public_search_text,m.class_name) search_text,m.create_time sort_time FROM t_oneshot m WHERE m.site_project_id=#{q.siteId} AND m.deleted=0 AND m.is_deleted=0 AND m.has_front_channel=1 AND m.page_type=0 AND m.status=3 AND YEAR(m.create_time)=#{q.year} AND MONTH(m.create_time)=#{q.month} AND m.id AND COALESCE(m.public_search_text,m.class_name) LIKE #{q.likePattern} ESCAPE '\\'
mapper.select: SELECT kind,record_id,menu_id,title,search_text,sort_time AS create_time FROM () candidates ORDER BY sort_time DESC,kind,record_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_oneshot SET public_search_text=#{text} WHERE id=#{menuId} AND site_project_id=#{siteId}
